instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Multi-brand online marketplace aggregating 300+ independent Portuguese artisan brands across fashion, home decor, and gourmet food categories. Dropship and marketplace model with centralized logistics for top sellers. Seeking to implement AI-powered visual search and dynamic pricing. The company has mature core business processes but struggles with the tension between running the existing operation efficiently and carving out resources for innovation. We have pockets of digital maturity in specific teams while other areas rely heavily on manual workflows and spreadsheets.
answers.pastInitiatives: We have a mature innovation program with a dedicated R&D lab of 12 engineers, an annual innovation budget equivalent to 5% of revenue, and a structured stage-gate process for evaluating and funding new initiatives. In the past 3 years we have launched 4 new product lines that now contribute 18% of total revenue, including an AI-powered recommendation engine that has become our fastest-growing SKU.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

input.changes_since_last: Post-merger integration underway. Team doubled to 8 members. Culture clash between legacy and new teams.

opportunities.title: Centralized Process Streamlining & Workflow Automation (Post-Merger)
opportunities.rationale: The ongoing merger and manual processes represent the single biggest drag on EBITDA margins. By standardizing key operational workflows (e.g., vendor onboarding, inventory reconciliation) across both legacy and new teams, Synapse can achieve immediate cost savings and improve data reliability, directly addressing the efficiency goal.

first_actions: Map 3 high-volume cross-functional processes (e.g., PO to receipt).
Identify specific manual touchpoints suitable for RPA/low-code implementation.
Establish a temporary process governance task force including members from both merged legacy and new teams.
resources_needed: Initial budget allocation for automation tools (RPA licensing)
Executive sponsorship to enforce adoption across departments
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average cycle time for targeted processes by 25%
milestones: Completion of process mapping and gap analysis (Month 1)
Pilot implementation of automation for one key workflow (Month 3)
Training and mandatory adoption across target teams (Month 4)

opportunities.title: Developing Margin-Focused Cost Modeling for AI Recommendations
opportunities.rationale: The existing AI recommendation engine is excellent for revenue growth, but the board requires margin improvement. This opportunity evolves the current platform to integrate cost data (dropship costs, logistics unit pricing) directly into the recommender system's scoring algorithm, shifting focus from pure volume to profitable units.

first_actions: Integrate granular COGS/logistics data feeds into the analytics infrastructure.
Develop a profitability score weight (margin %) and test its impact against existing revenue weights.
Run A/B tests comparing current top-selling items vs. margin-optimized recommendations.
resources_needed: Testing infrastructure for live market simulation
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in overall gross profit percentage derived from recommended SKUs by 100 basis points.
milestones: Data integration and validation of all relevant COGS data (Month 2)
Development and internal testing of the weighted margin model (Month 3)
Deployment of pilot program with measurable profitability uplift (Month 4)

next_steps.action: Formalize the integration playbook, assigning process owners responsible for bridging workflows between legacy and new systems.
Conduct a dedicated cross-functional workshop (Finance, Tech, Ops) to quantify the ROI of automation efforts identified in Opp_A3.
Establish a cross-departmental 'Innovation Steering Committee' with members from all major functions to ensure strategy alignment and resource commitment.

key_weaknesses: Internal process fragmentation due to post-merger integration conflicts (Culture Clash)
Over-reliance on manual workflows and spreadsheets for core operational data capture.
Lack of defined, measurable ROI metrics that link innovation activities directly to cost reduction/EBITDA improvement.

improvements: Significant increase in R&D capacity and specialized talent (doubled team size).
Formalized innovation process structure remains robust, demonstrating strong internal commitment.
Successful initiation of key strategic projects (Opp_1/Opp_4) using dedicated resources.
persistent_gaps: Systemic gaps in core operational processes that are still relying on manual inputs, hindering scalable efficiency gains.
Cultural friction and lack of standardized procedures across the newly merged teams remain a blocker for full process adoption.
The strategic mandate (EBITDA improvement) requires tighter linkage between innovative tech output and granular cost management.
achieved_milestones: Successful completion of Phase 1 for initial automation assessment (Step 1 completed).
Continued progress on AI engine development, validating core technology capabilities.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Increased team size and R&D budget demonstrate commitment to innovation (positive). However, the persistence of manual processes, coupled with post-merger integration challenges, suggests that structural impediments are becoming more complex than previously assessed.
